items.title: ethresear.ch：31 位域上 WHIR 的 EVM 验证
items.note: 11:12（alxkzmn），WHIR 是基于哈希、可能具备后量子安全的证明组件，在 KoalaBear 域上打开 2^22 大小的多项式、100 位可证明安全时，一笔 EVM 交易约需 5,646,080 gas。
items.title_en: ethresear.ch: EVM Verification of WHIR over a 31-bit Field
items.note_en: 11:12 (alxkzmn). WHIR is a hash-based component that is plausibly post-quantum sound; opening a committed polynomial of size 2^22 over KoalaBear at 100 bits of provable soundness costs about 5,646,080 gas as an EVM transaction.

keywords_en: EIP-8266 expiring nonces for frame transactions
EIP-7928 clarifies the 7702 insufficient gas edge case
L2BEAT regenerates all of Lighter's ZK circuits
summary_en: nerolation submitted EIP-8266, adding expiring nonces to frame transactions. A clarification of the EIP-7928 edge case around 7702 with insufficient gas was submitted. rakita updated the SSTORE write cost condition in EIP-8038, and it was merged. L2BEAT for the first time regenerated all ZK circuits used by Lighter from source. ethresear.ch published an EVM verifier for WHIR over a 31-bit field.
